blocks.text: Jab bhi maddah tabee tabdeeli se guzarta hai to us ke saath energy ki tabdeeli hoti hai, aur yeh tabdeeli intermolecular forces ki mazbooti ke farq ki miqdari paimaish hai.

blocks.title: Molar heat of fusion
blocks.text: 1 atmosphere par apne melting point par ek mole solid ko pighla kar liquid banane ke liye jazb hone wali hararat ki miqdar molar heat of fusion, delta H f, hai. Barf se pani ke liye yeh 6.01 kJ fi mol hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ne barf (ice) ki molar heat of fusion 4.6 kJ mol-1 chhapi hai. Sahi qeemat taqreeban 6.01 kJ mol-1 hai (0 degrees C par ek mole barf pighlane ke liye). Pani ki heat of vaporization 40.6 kJ mol-1 sahi hai.

blocks.title: Molar heat of vaporization
blocks.text: 1 atmosphere par apne boiling point par ek mole liquid ko ek mole bukharat mein badalne ke liye jazb hone wali hararat ki miqdar molar heat of vaporization, delta H v, hai. Yeh intermolecular forces ki mazbooti par munhasir hai: 100 degrees C par ek mole pani bukharat mein badalne par 40.6 kJ fi mol jazb karta hai.

Ammonia aur hydrogen chloride ko apne boiling points par bukharat banne ke liye bil-tarteeb sirf 21.7 aur 15.6 kJ fi mol chahiye; farq pani mein mazboot intermolecular forces ki wajah se hai. Molar heats of fusion aur vaporization maddah ke zarraat par un ko ek doosre se door jane ki kaafi energy de kar asar karte hain, halat solid se liquid aur liquid se gas mein badalte hue; zarraat liquid aur gas phases mein harkat aur ghoomne ki zyada azadi pate hain. Barf ki heat of fusion glaciers aur barf ki chadron, qutbi barf samet, ke mutale mein aham hai.

blocks.prompt: Pani ki molar heat of vaporization hydrogen chloride se taqreeban teen guna kyun hai, aur barf ki heat of fusion qutbi barf ke liye kyun aham hai?
blocks.explanation: Liquid ko bukharat banane ka matlab us ke molecules ko poori tarah alag karna hai, to darkar hararat intermolecular forces napti hai. Pani ke molecules har ek do hydrogen bonds se bandhe hain; HCl molecules sirf kamzor dipole-dipole aur London forces se, to unhen azad karne mein kahin kam hararat lagti hai. Ek mole barf pighlane mein darja hararat barhe baghair us ki heat of fusion jazb hoti hai, to qutbi barf aur glaciers aahista pighalte hue bari miqdar mein hararat le sakte hain, jo tai karta hai ke mahol garam hone par woh kitni tezi se sukarte hain.

items: Molar heat of fusion: melting point par ek mole pighlane ki hararat (barf 6.01 kJ fi mol); molar heat of vaporization: boiling point par ek mole bukharat banane ki hararat (pani 40.6, NH3 21.7, HCl 15.6 kJ fi mol), mazboot forces ke liye zyada.
Hararat zarraat ko door jane aur azadi pane ki energy deti hai; barf ki heat of fusion glaciers aur qutbi barf ke liye aham hai.
